dedupe_keys.name: ics cyber attack datasets of tommy morris power system gas pipeline water storage tank

description: This page lists five industrial control system cyber attack datasets compiled by Tommy Morris and colleagues: power system datasets of synchrophasor measurements with Snort, control panel and relay logs (built with Oak Ridge National Laboratory), gas pipeline SCADA Modbus RTU logs formatted into feature sets, a gas pipeline and water storage tank dataset of attacks against two laboratory-scale control systems, a new gas pipeline set with more randomness, and 30 days of anonymised energy management system logs from an investor-owned utility. The data were produced at Mississippi State University and the University of Alabama in Huntsville. Files are available as ZIP archives in ARFF for WEKA, CSV or raw text, free to download from the page; no licence is stated, and users are asked to cite the named conference papers. Caveats: the page itself notes documented flaws in the gas pipeline and water tank data, the testbeds are small laboratory set-ups, and the collection has not been updated for about a decade. For simulation the datasets are used to train intrusion detectors and to parameterise cyber-attack scenarios in cascading failure and resilience models of pipelines and grids. They complement the HAI dataset and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS records in this catalogue.
